plan.adjustmentRateHint: How hard this process runs, as a fraction. 0.95 means the doses below are already 95% of the underlying recipe.
plan.columnsSectionHint: What the grid records each day. A dose column is a real material, so it reaches the season total and the cost.
plan.gridNeedsColumns: Add a column first — the grid has nothing to record yet.
plan.gridSectionHint: One row per day. A cell that is not a number is kept as written, so a day that skips feeding can say so.
plan.importUnmatched: No material matched: {{names}}. The columns were kept — link them by picking a material.
plan.memoPlaceholder: e.g. ÁP DỤNG CHO GIÁ THỂ XƠ DỪA
plan.memosSectionHint: Caveats that apply to the whole process
plan.noStages: No stages yet — the whole cycle reads as one.
plan.preparationSectionHint: Work that happens before day 1 — soaking seed, preparing growbags, sterilising the house. Stored as an offset (−14 = a fortnight before planting), so one process serves every crop; each crop turns it into real dates.
plan.referencePlantCountHint: The house size the doses below were written for. A crop with a different plant count rescales them automatically.
plan.seedCountHint: Not the plant count — the sheets state both
plan.stagesSectionHint: Named spans of the cycle. Stored as day ranges, so two days in one span can never disagree.
plan.targetHint: What is being grown, e.g. PI 52
